d:
Anthropic is preparing for a potential IPO, but one of the most influential figures in its governance is not its CEO, Dario Amodei, or its president, Daniela Amodei. It is Neil ‘Buddy’ Shah, a global health executive who chairs Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust.
Shah does not run Anthropic's daily operations or build its Claude AI models. Yet the trust he chairs has the power to appoint and remove a majority of the company's board of directors. He is also barred from directly owning Anthropic stock as a trustee.
